title: Strategy
description: Produced by the Beat 0.5 strategy agent from BRIEF-BUNDLE.md. Encodes the strategic POV for the entire prototype: cornerstone surface, IA philosophy, motion personality, content voice. Downstream agents (screens, IA, style-baseline, every screen-fill) read this to make consistent choices.

cornerstoneScreen.description: The route path that is the heart of the experience. Other screens funnel toward this. Must match a path in screens.json.

cornerstoneJustification.description: 1-3 sentence explanation of WHY this screen is the cornerstone.

iaPhilosophy.description: How the user navigates the app.

jtbd.description: Job to be done in one sentence.

motionPersonality.description: Style of animation throughout the app.

contentVoice.description: Tone of copy across the app.

densityTarget.description: Information density of the dashboard / list screens.

visualReferences.description: External references the user pointed at (image paths or URLs). Treated as visual intent signals only.

keyInteractions.description: List of cornerstone interaction patterns the prototype must expose. Each is a one-line description.

navigationPolicy.description: Cornerstone reachability constraint. The cornerstone must be ≤N clicks from the dashboard.
